description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing DES and 3DES encryption algorithms, including ECB and CBC modes, for Infineon hardware. Contains driver registration, key setup, and hardware interaction functions.

methods.name: des_setkey
methods.description: Sets DES key for crypto transformation, expands key, handles weak keys.

methods.name: des_setkey_skcipher
methods.description: Sets DES key for skcipher transform, calls des_setkey.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des
methods.description: Main interface to hardware DES encryption/decryption with support for multiple modes.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ecb
methods.description: Configures hardware for ECB mode and processes data.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cbc
methods.description: Configures hardware for CBC mode and processes data.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ofb
methods.description: Configures hardware for OFB mode and processes data.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_cfb
methods.description: Configures hardware for CFB mode and processes data.

methods.name: ifx_deu_des_ctr
methods.description: Configures hardware for CTR mode and processes data.

methods.name: des3_ede_setkey
methods.description: Sets 3DES EDE key, expands key, checks for weak keys.

methods.name: des3_ede_setkey_skcipher
methods.description: Sets 3DES EDE key for skcipher, calls des3_ede_setkey.
